svg.title: Crack defence: Isometric diorama
svg.desc: Crack defence (2D): the crack is a diorama of bark blocks, held by five barricade lines. Captain Burr's warriors, spears up, stand at the near lines while a huge ground beetle pushes against the far barricade; an amber pool of sap-glue slows it. The bar above shows five notches, one already lost, and the beetle's will draining.
